field.label: Enable toolkit
field.comment: Master switch. Off is core behaviour for all three fixes below.

field.label: Export legacy grid values, not their HTML
field.comment: Legacy grids render their CSV and Excel exports through the same renderers as the page, so an ampersand leaves as & and an apostrophe as '. On, an exported cell carries the value. Affects the export files only — never a rendered admin page.

field.label: Drop allowlisted joins from the order grid count
field.comment: The pager's COUNT(*) inherits every join the grid added to render its columns. On, joins named in the module's di.xml allowlist are removed from the count when nothing in it refers to them. With an empty allowlist — the default — this does nothing.

field.label: Give an admin reorder its own increment ID
field.comment: Core treats an admin reorder like an order edit: the new order inherits the original's increment ID with a "-1" suffix and a relation back to it, and a second reorder of the same order fails on the duplicate. On, a reorder takes its increment ID from the store's order sequence. Order edits are unaffected.
